root_idea.summary: An extended line, mark, or trace.
root_idea.development: The root develops from a mark extending across a surface to writing, marked-out land, paths, striped objects, and related notions of a condition or affair laid out for someone.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form rather than the imperfect QAC lemma.

senses.usage_conditions: In the attested Quranic construction, the written object is expressed as the object of the verb and the writing instrument or means may be expressed with بِـ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw or make a line or mark on the ground or another surface; in the conventional practice of geomancy, to draw lines for divination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The geomantic use involves making lines or marks on soft ground and interpreting them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figuratively, to deliberate over an affair and consider its possible outcome.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on making lines on the ground while pondering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To walk or go along.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical construction with the feet or the ground as the complement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prohibit something, or to take or appropriate it for oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction with عَلَى; the two interpretations are reported for this usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut or cleave with a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical usage, including cleaving a person or thing in two.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an expression, for the rain-bearing star or asterism to pass over a land and fail to bring it rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form and derivation of this expression are disputed in the transmitted explanations; it is retained as a restricted classical expression rather than a core general sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mark with lines, streaks, or stripes; also to weave cloth in stripes or draw lines skillfully.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II derived usage concerning the production or arrangement of lines.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mark out and take a plot or place for oneself, settle there, and build upon it; hence, to found a town or similar settlement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plot is marked to show that it has been chosen for habitation or construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the face or beard, to become marked with lines as the beard grows along the sides of the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the emergence or extension of beard hair on the two sides of the face, especially in a boy or young man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A line, streak, or stripe; including a mathematical line and a streak of herbage across the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may refer to a visible difference in color, vegetation, or surface, and is also used in mathematical terminology.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A track, path, road, or street, including a common thoroughfare.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A line of passage through plain, smooth, or soft ground, or a recognized road or way.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Writing, handwriting, or the character and particular form of written letters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the nominal writing sense, distinct in headword and category from the Quranic Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place or territory of a tribe.
An affair, matter, case, event, state, condition, quality, or property; especially a difficult, serious, or evil matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote a circumstance requiring resolution or a condition in which someone finds himself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A course, way, or line of action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may refer to the course one takes in pursuing an affair, including a course of exacting one's due equitably.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A proof, evidence, testimony, argument, plea, or allegation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal or disputational construction equivalent to presenting a حجّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An object of desire or purpose that one has resolved to accomplish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an objective held in mind before undertaking it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Boldness or readiness to undertake affairs.
Ignorance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported in the expression فِي رَأْسِهِ خُطَّةٌ; some authorities instead interpret that expression as referring to an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plot of unoccupied land that a person marks and takes for building, habitation, or settlement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term includes the marked site and, in some explanations, the house or settlement established there; it underlies descriptions of planned settlements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The marks or outward signs of generous or honorable qualities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plural-based expression referring to qualities displayed in a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wild bull, or another beast that marks the ground with the extremities of its hooves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived descriptive noun centered on the animal's tracks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land, or a valley, left without rain between or among areas that have received rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is also used when one part of an area has received rain and another has not; the derivational relation to this root is disputed in the root-level discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A condition of abasement or humiliation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use derived from the expression for a rainless strip or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A strip of ground differing in roughness or smoothness from the ground on either side.
A practitioner of geomancy, the divinatory practice of drawing lines.
A calligrapher or practitioner of the art of writing.
A spear associated with al-Khatt, especially one of the spears brought through that coastal station and sold or straightened there.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective used substantively or with رُمْحٌ; it is a geographical designation, not a general description of a marked object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Delicate in beauties.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed tropical adjectival usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place marked with a line, streak, or stripe.
A wooden instrument used for making lines or marks, including the weaver's instrument for marking cloth.
Marked with lines, streaks, or stripes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to garments, dates, wild animals, or other things bearing such markings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beautiful, especially of a boy whose beard has appeared in lines along the sides of his face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical adjectival use associated with the marked appearance of the developing beard.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooden ruler or instrument used to make lines even.
A book or similar object written in or upon.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers literal marking, geomantic lines, figurative deliberation, and walking usage.
Restricted expression concerning a rain-bearing star passing over land.
Form II marking, striping, weaving, and drawing usage.
Marking and taking a plot for settlement or building.
Face or beard becoming marked with lines.
Beard growth is covered by the broader beard-marking meaning.
Noun sense of line, streak, or stripe.
Mathematical line is covered by the noun line meaning.
Track, path, road, and thoroughfare sense.
Herbage arranged in streaks is covered by line or stripe.
Place or territory of a tribe.
Affair, case, condition, quality, and difficult-matter branch.
Reported alternatives of affair and ignorance are both preserved.
Marked plot taken for building or habitation.
Animal characterized by marking the ground with its hooves.
Valley or land missed by rain.
Strip of ground differing from its surroundings.
Place marked with lines or stripes.
Tropical adjectival use associated with beard lines.
Wooden ruler for making even lines.

cautions: The Lane and Maqayis material is supplied under the contracted heading خَط for the canonical geminate root خطط.
The expression خَطَّ اللهُ نَوْءَهَا has disputed transmitted forms and derivation; it is presented only as a restricted classical expression, not as a general Quranic sense.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The rain-missing expression in lane-unit:xTT:19458:g1:sub8 is retained cautiously because Lane reports competing forms and Maqayis treats the rainless-land branch as etymologically separate.
